content.en: Remove 5 random Company cards. Deal 3 hidden cards and 10 one-value Capital chips to each player. Put the remaining deck face down and leave an empty Market beside it.
content.zh: 随机移除 5 张牌。每人拿 3 张手牌与 10 枚 1 点资本。剩余牌面朝下放成牌堆，旁边留出市场放公开牌。

title.zh: 每回合：摸 1 张 → 打 1 张

content.en: First take one Company card from either the deck or Market. Then choose exactly one card from your hand and place it into your portfolio or the Market.
content.zh: 先从牌堆摸，或从市场拿，得到 1 张牌；再从手里打 1 张到自己面前或市场。

title.zh: 摸牌要付钱，拿市场牌拿钱

content.en: A deck draw makes every Market card cost one Capital chip. A Market pick gives you its card and every chip accumulated on it. You must still place one card from your hand afterward.
content.zh: 从牌堆摸会给市场每张牌各放一枚资本；从市场拿则把牌和压在上面的资本一起拿走。之后还要从手里打 1 张。

alt.en: Drawing from the deck costs one Capital chip on every Market card; taking a Market card collects all Capital chips on it
alt.zh: 从牌堆抽牌时须在市场每张牌上放一枚资本；从市场拿牌时可连同其上所有资本一起获得

title.en: Draw Only If You Can Fund the Market

content.en: Draw the top deck card, then put one 1-value Capital chip on every Market card. If you lack enough chips for all those cards, choose the Market instead.
content.zh: 摸牌堆顶牌，然后给市场每张牌各放一枚 1 点资本。资本不够给完所有市场牌，就不能这样摸。

content.en: Take one face-up Market card and all Capital chips on it. This turn, you cannot put a card of that same company into the Market; place it in your portfolio or choose another company for the Market.
content.zh: 拿一张市场公开牌和上面所有资本。这回合不能把同一家公司的牌放回市场；可以打到自己面前，或改打另一家公司进市场。

title.zh: 打到自己面前，或补进市场

content.en: Put exactly one hand card face up into your portfolio or the Market. A portfolio card can change the majority shareholder, so immediately update that company’s Anti-Monopoly chip.
content.zh: 从手里打 1 张：放自己面前就是投资，放牌堆旁就是补市场。打到自己面前可能改变谁持股最多，立刻更新指示物。

content.en: The sole largest portfolio holder takes that company’s Anti-Monopoly chip. A tie stays with the earlier holder. The holder cannot take its Market cards and skips adding Capital to them after a deck draw.
content.zh: 谁面前该公司牌最多，谁拿反垄断指示物；并列时原持有人继续拿。拿着它的人不能从市场拿这家公司牌，从牌堆摸牌时也不用给这些市场牌放资本。

alt.en: The sole largest shareholder holds a company’s Anti-Monopoly chip, which protects that company’s Market shares from two costs
alt.zh: 唯一最大股东持有该公司的反垄断指示物，它让该公司市场中的股份免受两种成本影响

title.zh: 摸到最后一张：摊牌，分钱

content.en: After the final deck card is drawn, finish that turn. Add all hands to portfolios. For each company, every minority holder pays one 3-value Capital chip per share to the sole majority holder; a tie pays nobody.
content.zh: 摸到最后一张牌后，先完成这回合的“打 1 张”。所有人摊开手牌放到自己面前。逐家公司看谁牌最多：其他持股者每有 1 张，就付给唯一最大股东 1 枚 3 点资本；第一名并列则不分钱。

alt.en: After the final deck card is drawn, add hands to portfolios; each minority share pays three Capital to the sole majority shareholder
alt.zh: 抽到牌堆最后一张牌后，将手牌加入投资组合；每一张非最大股东的股份向唯一最大股东支付三点资本

content.en: Total Capital and point chips. Highest value wins; break ties by most 3-value chips, then the player who played most recently. For the optional campaign, score +2/+1/−1 for first/second/last over four rounds.
content.zh: 合计资本与分数指示物，数值最高者获胜；平手时比较 3 点资本数量，再比较最后出牌者。可选战役模式进行四轮，每轮第一／第二／最后分别获得 +2／+1／−1。
